# Design notes (v0.1, early beta)

## Records (all generated by `src/plugin/BlackshieldCompany.Generator`)

| EditorID | Type | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `BSC_CompanyQuest` | Quest (start game enabled) | Runs `BSC_CompanyScript`: courier letter, ledger menus, pay, ranks, treasury, sellsword. Alias `Sellsword` (optional, protected). |
| `BSC_ContractClear` | Quest | Location alias: bandit camp with a Boss ref, inside `CompanionsRadiantAllowedHolds`, not cleared. Target alias = the location's Boss. |
| `BSC_ContractBounty` | Quest | Location alias: any dungeon with a map marker (cleared allowed). Target created at the map marker from `BSC_LCharMarkedTarget`, plus 2 optional bandit bodyguards. |
| `BSC_ContractHold` | Quest | Location alias: military fort with a map marker (cleared allowed). Within 2500 units of the marker, 3 waves of `LCharBanditMeleeAny` spawn at the marker and attack. |
| `BSC_Joined`, `BSC_Rank`, `BSC_Renown`, `BSC_Treasury`, `BSC_ContractsDone`, `BSC_ContractActive` | Globals | State. Readable with `show <name>` in the console. |
| `BSC_TreasuryShare` (0.2), `BSC_IntroMinLevel` (2), `BSC_PayMult` (1.0) | Globals | Tunables. Change with `set <name> to <value>`. |
| `BSC_PowerLedger` + `BSC_LedgerEffect` | Lesser power + script effect | Opens the ledger. |
| `BSC_Letter`, `BSC_Ledger` | Books with `OnRead` scripts | Recruitment offer and ledger menu. |
| `BSC_BlackshieldBlade` / `Shield` / `Plate` | Weapon / Armor | Rank rewards. They reuse vanilla ebony sword, ebony shield and steel plate cuirass meshes. Flagged `MagicDisallowEnchanting`, so they can't be disenchanted. |
| `BSC_AbCommander` | Ability | +25 Health and +25 Stamina. |
| `BSC_Sellsword` | NPC templated on `LCharBanditMeleeAny` (traits/stats/spells) | Company follower in `PotentialFollowerFaction`, recruited through `DialogueFollowerScript.SetFollower`. |
| `BSC_Target01..05` + `BSC_LCharMarkedTarget` | NPCs templated on `LCharBanditBoss` (everything but name) | Bounty targets. |
| `BSC_Msg*` | Messages | All menus and notifications. Each rank has its own ledger menu so the rank name can be shown. |

## Flow

1. `BSC_CompanyScript.OnInit` polls every 30 s until the player is level ≥ `BSC_IntroMinLevel`, out of combat, has controls, and MQ101 (Helgen) is not running. Then it shows the courier message and adds the letter.
2. Reading the letter (`OnRead`, deferred until menus close) offers the contract. Signing adds the ledger book, the power and 100 gold.
3. Taking a contract calls `Stop/Reset/Start` on the contract quest. The engine fills the radiant aliases. If filling fails, the player sees "No contract of that kind…".
4. `BSC_ContractScript` polls every 4 s while running. On success it calls `BSC_CompanyScript.ContractCompleted(type)`, which pays out, banks the treasury share, adds renown and promotes the player (possibly several ranks at once).

## Pay formula

`pay = (base + 15 × level) × (1 + 0.1 × rank) × BSC_PayMult`, ×1.25 at Commander. Base pay is 300 for clear, 250 for bounty and 350 for hold. Renown is 50, 40 and 60. The treasury takes `floor(pay × BSC_TreasuryShare)`. Abandoning a contract costs 10 renown.

## Deferred (not in v0.1)

- A recruiter NPC placed in a tavern with dialogue. That needs a cell edit and voiced or silent dialogue authoring, which would be better done in the Creation Kit.
- Escort contracts, which need AI package authoring and testing.
- An MCM settings page (SkyUI). The tunables are console globals for now.
- More than one sellsword, a company hall, and voiced lines.
